news.title: Kindel back at Penguins practice after medical emergency

news.description: Penguins forward Ben Kindel returned to practice on Tuesday, a week after the 19-year-old fainted on the team's flight back from Utah.

news.title: Connor Hellebuyck eager to make Devils debut vs. Stars
news.ruTitle: Коннор Хеллебак хочет дебютировать в матче «Девилз» против «Старз»
news.description: Connor Hellebuyck will make his New Jersey debut against the Stars on Tuesday, just four days after the trade that ended his standoff with the Winnipeg Jets.

news.title: Calgary brings 4-game win streak into matchup against Edmonton
news.ruTitle: «Калгари» принес победную серию из 4 игр в матче против «Эдмонтона»
news.description: Calgary Flames (5-6, in the Pacific Division) vs. Edmonton Oilers (8-2-2, in the Pacific Division)

news.title: Red Wings' Michal Postava a winner in first career NHL start
news.ruTitle: Михал Постава из «Ред Уингз» стал победителем своего первого старта в карьере в НХЛ
news.description: Michal Postava made his first career NHL start a memorable one, backstopping the Red Wings to a shootout win over the Oilers.

news.title: Raymond scores in shootout to lift Red Wings to 4-3 decision over Oilers
news.ruTitle: Рэймонд забивает в серии пенальти и выводит "Ред Уингз" со счетом 4:3 над "Ойлерз"
news.description: — Lucas Raymond scored the only goal of the shootout and had a pair of assists in regulation as the Detroit Red Wings beat the Edmonton Oilers 4-3 on Monday night.

news.title: Matvei Gridin scores twice as Flames beat Maple Leafs 5-2
news.ruTitle: Матвей Гридин забивает дважды, когда «Флэймз» обыграли «Мэйпл Лифс» со счетом 5–2
news.description: — Matvei Gridin scored twice as the surging Calgary Flames made it four straight wins with a 5-2 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Monday night.

news.title: Kings continue hot Eastern Conference trip with 6-3 win over Rangers
news.ruTitle: «Кингз» продолжают горячую поездку в Восточную конференцию, победив «Рейнджерс» со счетом 6:3
news.description: — Drew Doughty had a goal and two assists, and Artemi Panarin added a power-play goal and an assist as the Los Angeles Kings beat the New York Rangers 6-3 on Monday night.

news.title: James Reimer's Rangers debut lasts one period after giving up 3 goals vs. Kings
news.ruTitle: Дебют Джеймса Реймера в «Рейнджерс» продлился один период после того, как он пропустил 3 гола в матче с «Кингз».
news.description: James Reimer's debut for the Rangers was over after just one period after the 38-year-old allowed three goals on eight shots against the Kings.
